shots.name: 12-loss
shots.note: LOSS — half of every message type dropped, on both hops, on top of 180 ms ± 60. The rung the surface lands on is whatever the AGE says, because a dropped frame is indistinguishable from a frame that was never sent — which is the honest reading, and the reason the ladder is built on age rather than on socket liveness
